title: manni stewardship strict overlay v1.0.0
description: The strict overlay for manni:stewardship:1.0.0. Stack it beside the open vocabulary. It narrows the form of values the open vocabulary already claims and requires no key.

authors.description: Strict takes authors as a list of unique entries. A string entry is one line with no surrounding space. A person object names the person, and its `email` and `url` are well formed.

owner.description: Strict holds each owner to a handle a GitHub or GitLab CODEOWNERS file accepts, in the string form and the list form alike.

stakeholders.description: Strict holds each stakeholder to one line with no surrounding space. A stakeholder is a person or team, named in any form.

reviewed-by.description: Strict holds each reviewer to one line with no surrounding space. `manni meta derive` writes review-API logins and commit-trailer names, so no handle form is required.

created.description: Strict holds the creation date to an RFC 3339 full date or date-time. A year or month alone fails, and so does a timestamp without seconds.

last-updated.description: Strict holds the update date to an RFC 3339 full date or date-time. A year or month alone fails, and so does a timestamp without seconds.

last-reviewed.description: Strict holds the review date to an RFC 3339 full date or date-time. A year or month alone fails, and so does a timestamp without seconds.

verified-against.description: Strict requires an object entry to carry `name` and `version`, alone or in a list. The version's format stays free, and a string entry is unchanged. The top-level `required` holds the single-object form, and `items` holds each object in a list, since `required` applies only to an object.

source-of-truth.description: Strict requires an object entry to carry `path` or `url`, alone or in a list. A string entry is one id, path or URL on one line with no surrounding space. The top-level `$ref` holds the string and single-object forms, and `items` holds each entry in a list, since `required` applies only to an object.

handles.description: A handle a CODEOWNERS file accepts, as a string or as each member of a list. That is `@user`, `@org/team`, a GitLab nested group or `@@role`, or an email address.

names.description: One line with no surrounding space, as a string or as each member of a list.

date.description: An RFC 3339 full date, or a date-time with seconds and an offset.

source.description: A source entry. A string is one id, path or URL on one line with no surrounding space. An object carries `path` or `url`.
